_note: MINERVA's target lists in their Google Sheet, read by robofast_core.sites.minerva.target_sheet (docs/minerva_sheet.md):
Copy this file to the control host and fill in the placeholders there; never commit the real values.
key_file: MINERVA's Google service-account key (JSON) in /etc/robofast/secrets/, mode 600, owned by the service user;
a key readable by group or others, or inside a git work tree, is refused. $ROBOFAST_MINERVA_SHEETS_KEY overrides it;
sheet: each list's spreadsheet key (the long id in the Sheet's URL; legacy minerva-control has it in
bstars: limit soft -- after per_night B stars a further one is still taken when nothing else is observable.
The red-side list is retired (docs/minerva_sheet.md); a list entry of its own brings it back.
instrument: the spectrograph's instrument_type in dispatch.example.json (required).
snapshot_dir: omitted, snapshots go to $ROBOFAST_DATA_DIR/minerva_sheet (robofast_core.zenodo.data_dir); keep: how many.

targets.sheet: <spreadsheet key of the MINERVA target list>

bstars.sheet: <spreadsheet key of the MINERVA target list>
